name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Menu hung on a trigger you supply: keyboard navigation, portal and ARIA are built in, so spread `triggerProps` onto your own button. Items, sections and dividers are the parts. When the trigger is an ordinary labelled button, `<ButtonGroup menu>` is that already assembled — including the split form where a default action sits on its own half. Come here when the trigger is something else: an avatar

files.content: export { Dropdown, DropdownItem, DropdownSection, DropdownDivider } from './Dropdown'
